user.title: Set up DomoSenso Frame
user.description: Choose what to add. The bridge serves the frame endpoint for the Android app; albums sync shared Synology Photos albums into a photo folder for Ramka.

bridge.title: Set up DomoSenso Frame
bridge.description: Create one frame endpoint for the Android app. No custom dashboard or YAML is needed. You can edit source mappings later in the DomoSenso Frame sidebar.

sources.title: Choose optional sources
sources.description: Select only the sources you want this frame to use. All fields are optional; an empty selection starts with the clock. {suggested_count} eligible sources carry component markers; markers are hints, never automatic permission. Air sensors show measurements without invented quality thresholds. After submitting, open DomoSenso Frame in the sidebar for source mappings, templates and device pairing. Compare the six-digit code on the tablet before approving it.

albums.title: Set up photo albums
albums.description: Shared albums are copied into this folder as screen-sized JPEG files. Everything in it is readable without login when it lies under /config/www, so add only albums you are fine to show there. Add albums afterwards with Configure.

error.invalid_settings: Enter a frame name of 1–80 characters and choose a supported language.
error.invalid_sources: Select existing sources of the indicated type. Use at most 32 temperature sensors, 32 air sensors and 16 calendars, without duplicates.
error.invalid_photo_dir: Enter the absolute path of an existing folder, for example /config/www/ramka.

abort.already_configured: This part of DomoSenso Frame is already configured. For the bridge, open DomoSenso Frame in the sidebar to edit source mappings or pair a tablet. For albums, use Configure on the albums entry.
abort.yaml_configured: DomoSenso Frame is configured in YAML. Existing endpoints and grants are preserved. Open DomoSenso Frame in the sidebar and use Map sources or Devices and pairing. UI setup does not replace YAML.

init.title: Photo albums
init.description: Add or remove a shared album, sync now or change the settings.

add_album.title: Add album
add_album.description: Paste a Synology Photos share link, with its password if it has one. The first sync runs now and can take a while for a large album.

data_description.path: Leave empty to use year/month/album name, for example 2026/11/Holiday.

remove_album.title: Remove album
remove_album.description: Deletes the photos this album synced and its sync marker. The folder is deleted only if nothing else is left in it; files you added by hand stay. The shared album itself is not changed.

sync_now.title: Sync now
sync_now.description: Leave the album empty to sync all albums. The sync runs in the background; the Albums sensor shows the result.

settings.title: Album settings
settings.description: Host map lines read `from -> to`, each an origin such as https://photos.example.com, to reach the share host by another address (for example on the local network). Redirects are not followed: map to the address that answers directly, for example the https address if http redirects there.

error.invalid_link: This is not a Synology Photos share link (https://host/mo/sharing/…) or it contains credentials.
error.wrong_password: The link password is wrong or missing.
error.unreachable: The share host cannot be reached. Check the link, the network or the host map.
error.invalid_host_map: Each line must read `from -> to`, where both sides are an origin only: http or https, host and optional port, without path, query, trailing slash or user name.
error.album_busy: This album is syncing right now. Try again when the sync has finished.
error.share_error: The first sync of this album failed. Check the link, the photo folder and the free disk space, then try again.

abort.not_loaded: The albums entry is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.no_albums: No albums have been added yet.

album_awaiting_confirmation.title: Album {name} waits for confirmation
album_awaiting_confirmation.description: More than half of the photos of album {name} ({path}) disappeared from the share, so no photo was deleted. If this is intended, call the action domosenso_frame.album_sync with this album and confirm_deletions, or use Sync now with Confirm held deletions.

album_path_collision.title: Album {name} was placed in another folder
album_path_collision.description: The wanted folder for album {name} already belongs to something else, so the album was placed in {path}. Rename or move the other folder, or set a folder for this album, if you want it elsewhere.

album_add.name: Add album
album_add.description: Adds a shared Synology Photos album without a password and runs its first sync. A link with a password returns the album with status auth_failed: add such links in the integration options (Configure -> Add album).

path.name: Folder
path.description: Folder inside the photo folder; empty uses year/month/album name.

album_remove.name: Remove album
album_remove.description: Removes an album: deletes the photos it synced and its sync marker, and the folder only if nothing else is left in it.

album_id.name: Album ID
album_id.description: ID from the albums attribute of sensor.domosenso_frame_albums.

album_sync.name: Sync albums
album_sync.description: Syncs one album or all albums now.

album_id.name: Album ID
album_id.description: ID of the album to sync; empty syncs all.

confirm_deletions.name: Confirm deletions
confirm_deletions.description: Delete photos that a held sync kept because more than half disappeared.

invalid_link.message: Not a Synology Photos share link.
